description: A mock implementation of Git operations for testing purposes, including methods for branch management, commit handling, and file operations.

classes.name: MockGit
classes.description: A mock class simulating Git command interactions for testing.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the MockGit object with optional parameters for current working directory, filesystem, and executive.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a single path to the list of added paths.

methods.name: add_list
methods.description: Adds multiple paths to the list of added paths, optionally returning an exit code.

methods.name: has_working_directory_changes
methods.description: Checks if there are changes in the working directory; always returns False.

methods.name: ensure_cleanly_tracking_remote_master
methods.description: Placeholder method for ensuring tracking of remote master branch.

methods.name: current_branch
methods.description: Returns the current branch name.

methods.name: current_branch_or_ref
methods.description: Returns the current branch or reference.

methods.name: checkout_branch
methods.description: Placeholder for checking out a branch.

methods.name: create_clean_branch
methods.description: Placeholder for creating a new clean branch.

methods.name: delete_branch
methods.description: Placeholder for deleting a branch.

methods.name: supports_local_commits
methods.description: Indicates support for local commits; always returns True.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a path exists; always returns True.

methods.name: absolute_path
methods.description: Constructs an absolute path from components.

methods.name: commit_position
methods.description: Returns a fixed commit position number.

methods.name: commit_position_from_git_commit
methods.description: Returns a commit position based on a git commit hash.

methods.name: timestamp_of_revision
methods.description: Returns a fixed timestamp for a revision.

methods.name: commit_locally_with_message
methods.description: Records a commit message internally.

methods.name: local_commits
methods.description: Returns the list of recorded local commits.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a path.

methods.name: delete_list
methods.description: Deletes multiple paths.

methods.name: move
methods.description: Moves a file or directory from origin to destination.

methods.name: changed_files
methods.description: Returns an empty list, simulating no changed files.

methods.name: unstaged_changes
methods.description: Returns an empty dict, indicating no unstaged changes.
